messages:
Maya: Quick heads up — I sketched a rollout plan for a pricing & packaging experiment we should launch next week. Focus: FAQ clarity, calculator UX, and tier names. Need input on lead routing and CTA text.

Jon: Love it. Can you paste the current calc? I want to run a quick usability run against the new layout.

Maya: Pasted below (staging):
```
// Simple estimate proto
{
  users: 100,
  avg_tokens_per_request: 300,
  requests_per_user_day: 10
}
estimate -> tokens/day = users * requests_per_user_day * avg_tokens_per_request
```
Jon: Nice. For the experiment we should have 2 calc flows: Compact (single slider) vs Guided (stepper with common presets: prototype, internal, prod). Hypothesis: Guided reduces drop-off.

Elena: On tier names — can we avoid legacy "Pro/Business"? Options: Developer / Scale / Dedicated or Starter / Growth / Enterprise. Need names that map to product surface (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Frank: Routing: when someone uses calculator and selects "Dedicated" we should route to AE; if they pick Hosted < $1000/mo route to self-serve SDR playbook. Also capture checkbox: "I need an SLA" to force AE.

Maya: Agree. Proposed CTA mapping:
- Self-serve calc result -> "Create account & try" (collect email + org size)
- Eval-worthy (dedicated/Private/ > $1k) -> "Request capacity quote" -> opens lead form -> routes to AE queue
- SLA checkbox -> routes to Enterprise queue

Jon: For analytics, record these events: calc_open, calc_run, calc_preset, calc_result_view, calc_cta_click, calc_lead_type. We'll use these for funnel and lead scoring.

Elena: FAQ updates: people are confused about quantization/quality tradeoffs. Add Q: "How do quantized models affect output quality?" with short answer + link to benchmark thread. Also add a short blurb: "Which deployment is right for me?" with 3 bullet scenarios.

Maya: Can Marketing Bot post a thread in #general when we soft-launch the experiment on staging? Want quick feedback.

Marketing Bot: scheduled message -> "Pricing page playbook v1 deployed to staging: /staging/pricing. Tests: calc A/B, tier names variant A/B, FAQ content update. Ping @marketing for feedback." :loudspeaker:

Frank: One more ask — add a small checkbox in calc results: "I want a pricing walkthrough" which creates a calendar invite draft to AE and attaches the calc snapshot (JSON) to the lead. That should increase conversion.

Maya: Good idea. I'll add the calendar hook and the snapshot payload to the lead form.

Jon: I'll set up an Amplitude dashboard and a short Hotjar funnel for the calc flows. Can someone write 3 short copy variants for the primary CTA?

Elena: Copy options (short):
1) "Estimate your monthly cost"
2) "See a tailored price"
3) "Get an instant estimate"

Maya: Copy 2 is my fav for prospecting, 1 is more neutral. We'll A/B test.

Frank: OK if we aim to flip the experiment live Thu morning? Need staging smoke tests Wed evening.

Maya: Timeline sounds good. I'll open a quick Google doc with the playbook and assign owners. Will post link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
